newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer, spreads stable.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer, spreads stable.

text.p: COMEX copper settled firmer Wednesday but was unable to break above upside resistance though the LME spreads avoided any further significant easing, traders said.
March COMEX hit 108.10 cents on the day's high and created some resistance, said Bette Raptopoulos of Prudential Securities.
"We have to break decisively above that, and this is likely in the next few days," she added.
March COMEX settled 1.95 cents firmer at 107.95 cents per pound, traded 108.10 to 105.80 cents. Spot February went out 1.20 cents firmer at 108.40 cents.
Volume was modest at an estimated 7,500 lots, although the Copper Club events in New York drew to a close Wednesday and players began returning to their desks.
The LME backwardation was at $115/$125, largely unchanged for the day.
